label: Basic
description: Basic avatar. Best for the minimal markup: 1 photo at the default size with 2 letter initials kept as the fallback.

label: Fallbacks
description: Avatar with fallback. Best for photo free placeholders: 2 letter initials and a user icon, both on the muted fallback fill.

label: Sizes
description: Avatars with different sizes. Best for the built-in steps of the size prop, sm, md, row and lg, shown side by side.

label: Border Radius
description: Avatars with different corner rounding. Best for square, soft-cornered photos whose rounding grows with the size, next to a round one.

label: Custom Sizes
description: Avatars with custom sizes. Best for 16, 32, 48 and 64 point avatars, beyond the everyday presets.

label: Status Dots
description: Avatar with an online status badge. Best for presence dots in the bottom-right corner in primary, green, yellow and red, each named.

label: Badge Icons
description: Avatar with badge icon. Best for corner badges holding a plus, check, star or shield icon, each named for what it means.

label: Round Badge Corners
description: Avatar with different badge positions. Best for round photos with the dot moved to each of the 4 corners.

label: Square Badge Corners
description: Avatar with different badge positions. Best for square photos with the dot on each of the 4 corners.

label: Avatar Group
description: Basic avatar group. Best for a stack of 3 overlapping photos with a background ring and no count chip at the end.

label: Group With Count
description: Avatar group with numerical count. Best for a 3 photo stack closed by a muted chip from the group count part that reads +3.

label: Plus Chip Group
description: Avatar group with an icon count. Best for a 3 photo stack ending in a round plus chip in place of a number.

label: Border Rings
description: Avatar with a distinct border ring. Best for rings in 4 colours set off from the photo by a background gap.

label: Soft Fallbacks
description: Avatar with light background color fallback. Best for initials on soft tinted fills with a matching border, including dark mode shades for green and fuchsia.

label: Solid Fallbacks
description: Avatar with a solid background color fallback. Best for initials in white or primary foreground text on full strength primary, destructive, green and blue fills.

label: User Details
description: Avatar with user details and badge. Best for a name line with a small Pro badge and a job title stacked beside the photo.

label: Grayscale
description: Avatar with a muted look. Best for an inactive member's photo shown muted beside an active one (a phone image has no greyscale filter).

label: Group Presence
description: Avatar group with online status on one. Best for a 3 person stack where only the first photo carries a success colored presence dot.

label: Outline Button
description: Avatar inside small outline button. Best for a 20 pixel photo next to an @ handle inside a small outline button.

label: Social Proof Pill
description: Avatar social proof with text label. Best for a bordered pill with 4 small stacked photos and a bold 100K+ figure in its caption.

label: Compact Social Proof
description: Compact social proof with initials. Best for a Frame panel holding 4 developer photos and a Joined by 500+ developers caption.

label: Lift Tooltips
description: Avatar group with a tap to lift. Best for a stack where a tap lifts a photo and names it, the phone's take on hover tooltips.

label: Hover Fan
description: Avatar group that fans out. Best for a stack that spreads apart on a press and closes on the next, the phone's take on the hover fan.

label: Fan With Tooltips
description: Avatar group fan with names. Best for the fan with each person named under their photo once it opens.

label: Bordered Count Pill
description: Avatar group with numerical count. Best for a bordered pill of 4 small photos split by background borders, with a plain +3 text tally.

label: Pill Outline Button
description: Pilled small outline button with avatar. Best for a pill shaped outline button whose 24 pixel photo hugs its left edge inside a background border.

label: Pill Primary Button
description: Pilled small button with avatar. Best for a solid primary pill button with a thin primary border around the 24 pixel photo at its left.

label: Empty State
description: Avatar inside an empty state. Best for a no collaborators prompt with 3 muted photos, an add person chip and a button.

label: Group Add Button
description: Avatar group with icon count and button. Best for a 3 photo stack with a +5 chip beside a round add user button that shows a tooltip.

label: Loading State
description: Avatar with loading state. Best for a spinner over a veil on the photo, switched by a button.

label: Custom Badge
description: Avatar with custom badge. Best for a verified rosette placed at a different corner on each of 4 photos.

label: Pulsing Ring
description: Avatar with ring animation. Best for a green ring pulsing around a live photo with a presence dot, still with Reduce Motion.

label: Gradient Ring
description: Avatar with a gradient ring. Best for a story-style yellow to violet ring turning slowly round the photo, still with Reduce Motion.

label: Multiple Badges
description: Avatar with multiple badges. Best for a presence dot at the bottom right and a red count of 3 at the top right of one photo.

label: Dropdown Menu
description: Compact avatar dropdown menu. Best for a pill trigger with photo and name that opens Profile, Settings and Log out.
